memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, walks to market unaided, reports mild knee pain on stairs.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5, no impairment.
falls: No falls in past 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 11 seconds (normal).
medicines: 2 regular (topical diclofenac gel BD, calcium‑vitamin D3 OD); paracetamol 650 mg SOS for pain.
mood: Reports occasional worry about income, denies depression.
carers: Lakshmi, daughter.
goals: "I want to keep working at the vegetable stall without knee pain limiting me."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Weight‑bearing X‑ray both knees: mild joint space narrowing, marginal osteophytes, consistent with early osteoarthritis. No fracture.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Walks with occasional support of a cane, knee pain limits prolonged standing.
cognition: Mini‑Cog not due yet (next April 2026).
falls: One slip at market in past 3 months, no injury; gait mildly antalgic; timed up‑and‑go 13 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise strength exercises and supportive footwear.
medicines: 3 regular (paracetamol 650 mg QID, topical diclofenac gel BD, calcium‑vitamin D3 OD); paracetamol SOS for breakthrough pain.
mood: Reports frustration about reduced stall hours, denies depressive symptoms.
carers: Lakshmi, daughter.
goals: "I want to stand longer at my stall without needing to rest every few minutes."

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Knee pain worse when climbing stairs to my stall; I’ve been using the paracetamol more often, about 4 times a day.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Uses cane regularly, reports pain 5/10 on walking, manages stall with frequent breaks.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 3/5 (borderline) – plan for fuller cognitive assessment.
falls: No new falls; gait slow, timed up‑and‑go 15 seconds (raised risk) – continue physio, check footwear.
medicines: 4 regular (paracetamol 650 mg QID, topical diclofenac gel BD, calcium‑vitamin D3 OD, started gabapentin 100 mg HS for neuropathic component); paracetamol SOS.
mood: Feels low when unable to work full days, denies hopelessness.
carers: Lakshmi, daughter.
goals: "I want to reduce pain enough to work a full day at the market."

memories.text: Appointment changed: moved from 2026-06-01 10:00 to 2026-07-15 14:00 for follow‑up geriatric review.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Walks without cane most days, knee pain 3/10, manages stall independently.
cognition: Full MoCA performed, score 24/30 – mild cognitive impairment, continue monitoring.
falls: No falls in past year; gait normal, timed up‑and‑go 11 seconds (normal).
medicines: 3 regular (paracetamol 650 mg QID, topical diclofenac gel BD, calcium‑vitamin D3 OD); gabapentin tapered off.
mood: Reports improved mood, enjoys work.
carers: Lakshmi, daughter.
goals: "I want to stay active and pain‑free so I can keep supporting my family."
